explanation: A person who breaks God's laws and commands, and acts in opposition to his will.
Actions, thoughts, or attitudes that are morally wrong, harmful, or destructive, contrary to God's nature and will.
To act in accordance with God's will and morality, to be upright and good.
God's act of saving people from the consequences of sin and bringing them into a close relationship with him.
A title used to refer to God, emphasizing his authority and dominion over all things and everyone.
